steps.content: The path ahead is quieter than you expected.
Stone tiles stretch out beneath your feet, broken occasionally by metal inlays of a mismatched material, their edges scarred as if by intense heat.
You glance down, and a strange familiarity tugs at you. But there's no time to think. Around the corner, a sudden chaos of frantic footsteps rings out.
Close on their heels come a series of ricocheting thuds, the crackle of flames scraping the ground, and the raw, chittering noise of small contaminated entities jostling together.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? You guys hear that...? What's all that noise?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sounds like... when the servants chase me around at home.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I think it's more like someone running for their life...
The words barely land before a familiar figure bursts out staggering around the corner.
Her helmet displays a wild scramble of emotion, and she's running so breathlessly she looks like she just clawed her way out of some massive disaster.
And most importantly, she really does have a whole swarm of things on her tail.

There are translucent slimes, bouncing and jiggling, the kind that look like one wrong step would drench your legs in goo. There are burning monsters wreathed in pale blue flames, sparks flying with every step.
The creatures chase with relentless, single-minded focus, clearly locked onto their isolated prey. And the instant that prey spots you, her eyes—no, her helmet—practically light up on the spot.

steps.speaker: Demon looked at the bracelet on the ground in silence.
steps.content: H-heeeeelp!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...I feel like that's usually my line.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Those are just small fry. You could sweep 'em up with your laser easy. Why are you running like that?
EMP looks at Lynn with a puzzled expression.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... I wanna fight back too! But for some reason, no matter what I try, I just end up running away!
Lynn talks as she goes, circling around you in a restless orbit.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh! Now that's interesting! Way more interesting than my ability!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Wh-what's so interesting about this?! I just wanna rest for a second... Wait, hold on!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: You look... really familiar?! I think I just saw you in the cave! You were standing right behind those monsters!
Lynn looks at Murphy and promptly slips behind you, quick as a startled rabbit.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Huh...? I was? But I've been standing here the whole time! Could it be... are you sure you're not mixing me up with someone else?
You give Lynn a nod over your shoulder, and only then does she step out from behind you.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Sorry... I must've been mistaken then...
The conversation is barely underway when the pack of slimy creatures behind you lunges forward, shrieking.
At the front, a slime vaults high into the air. Murphy spots it and instantly yells a warning.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Run left first, then pause for just a second and cut right! Trust me! From experience, the slime won't be able to hit you if you do that!
Lynn takes the hint at once, but in the very next breath, a slime launches itself skyward with a wet splat, arcing straight toward her back.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Huh?! That's not right! How did it—?! EMP, help her, quick!
EMP is faster than Murphy's warning, but her arrow cuts through the air only to swerve, veering clean past the slime.
She'd assumed Murphy was joking about her bad luck before. Now, watching her surefire shot sail wide, she can only stare, dumbfounded.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: What the...?! How is that even possible?! My arrow just... curved. In midair. On its own!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: It's... It's okay! It'll work next time for sure! I'll bet tomorrow's breakfast on it. Guaranteed to hit!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...I mean, it's not like monsters are gonna start falling from the ceiling.
No sooner does Murphy speak than a wet noise rings out. A slime drops from thin air, looking utterly bewildered, and by sheer misfortune, lands square on Murphy's head.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Um... okay, I know I'm unlucky. But hey, nobody else got hurt just now! So maybe the rest of the fight will go a little smoother...?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh... I think that's the one I sent flying earlier.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I'm sorry... I'll just... stop talking now.
